```{r}
library(rpart)         
library(caret)        
library(dplyr)       
```

```{r}
data= read.csv("C:/Users/megha/Vent-Flow-Project-files/cleaned_vent_flow_data.csv",stringsAsFactors = FALSE,check.names = FALSE)

data$Classification=as.factor(data$Classification)
sapply(data,class)
```
```{r}
table(data$Classification)
```
## OVERSAMPLING : Non Serious

**Since data has only 7 features, SMOTE is likely to be effective and beneficial. It will help balance the classes without discarding any original data, and is supported by empirical and theoretical research for low-dimensional datasets.**
```{r}
library(smotefamily)
data$Classification_num=as.numeric(data$Classification == "Serious")
smote_output=SMOTE(X = data[, c("Flow_Rate_m3_day", "Stabilized_Shut_In_Pressure_kPa", "Source_Depth_mkb","Ground_Water_Base_mkb")],
                      target = data$Classification_num, K =5)
balanced_data=smote_output$data
balanced_data$Classification=factor(ifelse(balanced_data$class == 1, "Serious", "Non Serious"))
table(balanced_data$Classification)
names(balanced_data)
```




### Stratified K-Fold Cross-Validation : As classes are imbalanced, it ensures fair model evaluation
```{r}
set.seed(123)  
folds=createFolds(balanced_data$Classification, k = 5, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)
```

```{r}
results=data.frame(Accuracy = numeric(), Fold = integer())

for (i in 1:length(folds)) {
  test_idx=folds[[i]]
  test_data=balanced_data[test_idx, ]
  train_data=balanced_data[-test_idx, ]
  
  model=rpart(Classification ~ Flow_Rate_m3_day +
                Stabilized_Shut_In_Pressure_kPa+ 
                Source_Depth_mkb + Ground_Water_Base_mkb,
              data = train_data, method = "class")
  
  preds=predict(model, test_data, type = "class")#prediction
  acc=mean(preds == test_data$Classification)#accuracy
  misclass = 1 - acc#misclassification error
  
  results=rbind(results, data.frame(Accuracy = acc, MisclassError = misclass,Fold
                                       = i))
}

print(results)
```
```{r}
#Average accuracy : model's performance on test/unseen data
avg_acc=mean(results$Accuracy)
cat("Mean Accuracy:", round(avg_acc, 3),'\n')

avg_missclass=mean(results$MisclassError)
cat("Mean Misclassification Error:",round(avg_missclass,4))
```
```{r}
train_preds=predict(model, train_data, type = "class")
train_acc=mean(train_preds == train_data$Classification)
cat("Training Accuracy:", round(train_acc, 3))
```

```{r}
confusionMatrix(preds, test_data$Classification)
```
